sample.question:
The image shows a six-face cube net. The cube starts with U on top, F in front, and R on the right. A roll north/east/south/west moves the cube in that direction without twisting.
What is the minimum number of rolls needed to put Sun on top and Triangle in front at the same time?
A. 2
B. 4
C. 5
D. 3
E. 0
F. 1
sample.analysis: A breadth-first search over the 24 cube orientations finds an optimal sequence ['north', 'west', 'south'] of length 3. No orientation at a smaller depth meets both face constraints. The answer is D.
